settings.hero_lede: Vans, box trucks, shuttles and contractor pickups. We source the load-rated sizes your fleet runs and ship them wherever the trucks are — or fit them ourselves if you are in South Florida.
settings.why_lede: A tire is a small line item. A truck sitting in a waiting room for three hours is not. Everything below is built around keeping units on the road, wherever they run.
settings.cat_lede: Load Range E casings approved for dual fitment, priced per tire. Volume pricing applies to sets of eight or more.
settings.empty_heading: Commercial sizes are priced per quote
settings.empty_text: Commercial tires are not listed in the online catalog yet. Send us the sizes your fleet runs with the quote form below, or call [phone], and we will price them per tire and quote delivery to your yard.
settings.quote_lede: Tell us what you run and we will come back with per-tire pricing, delivery to your yard, and — if you are local — what it costs to have us fit them.
settings.privacy_note: We use these details to price your quote and schedule service — nothing else.
settings.ok_text: Thanks — we have your details. A fleet specialist will follow up by phone or email during shop hours.
settings.aside_text: Prefer to handle it on the phone? Call during shop hours and we will price your list while you are on the line.

settings.title: Shipped to your yard
settings.body: Orders drop-ship from the distributor straight to your address, anywhere in the continental US. No counter trips, no driver paid to wait.

settings.title: Local? We fit them too
settings.body: South Florida fleets can send the order free to our Sunrise shop, or book the van for a block before the route starts or after it ends.

settings.title: Fleet pricing on volume
settings.body: Sets of eight or more are quoted at fleet rates, with one consolidated invoice instead of a stack of counter receipts.

settings.title: Load-rated, not passenger-rated
settings.body: Load Range E casings, dual-fitment approved sizes and correct inflation for the axle weights your trucks actually carry.

settings.title: Rotation on a schedule
settings.body: Tell us your sizes and cycle and we keep the order list ready, so replacements are planned around your calendar instead of a blowout on the interstate.

settings.title: One number to call
settings.body: Tires, repairs and roadside swaps all come back to [phone] — no dispatch tree, no ticket queue.
